title: The boundaries of IIT's complexes are Markov blankets

statements.text: The boundaries of IIT's maximal complexes are also Markov blankets. Complexes of integrated information are Markov-blanket-bound networks of effective connectivity with high marginal likelihood and capacity for self-evidencing, which ties IIT's intrinsic information to information about the outside world.

sources.quote: With respect to IIT, the boundaries of maximal complexes (entailing maximally irreducible cause-effect structures) would also constitute MBs.
complexes of integrated information (as irreducible self-cause-effect power) are also Markov-blanket-bound networks of effective connectivity
